entities.title: Production
entities.summary: The deep-claim Worker at icelander.net/games/retro/deep-claim*, with its static game and no database.
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/retro/deep-claim/.
entities.deployedBy: The owner, from their own machine: `npm run deploy` in games/deep-claim (npm test, npm run test:godot, npm run build, wrangler deploy) with Godot 4.7.2 and its web export templates installed, with a Cloudflare token for the icelander.net account (or wrangler logged in to it). Nothing deploys from GitHub's runners: the Deploy workflow was removed (the owner's decision, 2026-11-21). Pull requests are still tested and built by CI, which installs Godot 4.7.2 for the Godot games game.yml lists, deep-claim among them.
approvals: The owner's decision: nothing deploys on its own, and only the owner runs the deploy.
A pull request, tested by CI, for anything that reaches main: main accepts nothing else.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded: check out an earlier commit and run npm run deploy again, or roll back the Worker's version in Cloudflare. There is no database to undo.
entities.details: The Worker's route runs ahead of the games hub's less specific icelander.net/games/*. workers_dev and preview URLs are off, so production is the only address.
